overview: Gita Companion is a deeply sacred, immersive spiritual platform delivering the complete Bhagavad Gita, Krishna AI guidance, 21 sacred pathways, a 38-book animated scripture library, and the Kurukshetra Sacred Story — designed to make Krishna's presence felt on every screen through vibrant temple aesthetics and full offline accessibility.
features: 21 Sacred Pathways including Bhagavad Gita Reader, Krishna AI Chatbot, Digital Mala, Naam Jaap, Virtual Temple, and Life Purpose Finder
38-book animated Vedic Library with Ashtavakra Gita, 4 Vedas, 18 Puranas, and rare scriptures — fully embedded
Kurukshetra Sacred Story — all 18 days with full detail, Gita verses, and sacred artwork
Roadmap to Moksha powered by Ashtavakra Gita teachings with Library interlinking
Virtual Temple with HD deity photos, day-specific idols, and animated offerings
Krishna AI deeply interlinked with Library — every answer points to exact book and chapter
Vibrant gold, saffron, lotus pink design — zero black backgrounds — love at first sight
Emergency Mode with 70+ helplines fully offline, user's personal railway station story
Garbha Sanskar 280-day pregnancy journey and Baby's Spiritual Passport
Antim Yaatra with all 13 Shradh days and Garuda Purana passages
Satsang Circles with internal community chat
Achievements, rewards, points store, and unlockable sacred books
